quotes.author: TripAdvisor
quotes.text: We had a window of just a few hours to visit with family in from out of town. As our group included two teenage grandsons, a stuffy restaurant was out of the question; the two hour dinner cruise was the ideal solution. Booking was easy. Boarding was prompt. Onboard service was excellent (thank you, Jesse and Juanita!) and everyone enjoyed their meal. The weather was perfect and the music was a big plus! Given the opportunity, we’d do it again - every time!

quotes.author: TripAdvisor
quotes.text: Can't say enough about this experience. The crew went above and beyond our expectations. The dinner was excellent...We always have our special places to see in Laughlin and now this is number one on the list. Thank you so very much for an awesome time. Can't wait to go again.

quotes.author: TripAdvisor
quotes.text: The people are kind, efficient and just overall wonderful. HIGHLY recommend this dinner cruise as it is so relaxing after a warm day. The staff are considerate, efficient and sooo friendly. I can't say enough good about these people.

quotes.author: TripAdvisor
quotes.text: The Celebration Boat dinner cruise is 5 star from arriving on board to fantastic servers and chef prepared meals that are perfectly made to your specifications. They made our Anniversary an evening we will remember.

quotes.author: TripAdvisor
quotes.text: My hubz and I go on this cruise everytime we go to Laughlin. The food is great and the atmosphere is romantic. It's a short break from the tables and we love it!!

quotes.author: Anonymous
quotes.text: The staff is always welcoming and they are fun!! Love the food and music. When we have guests come to visit, this is the first thing we book.
